review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the Git history of state/streeling/courses at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (73 commits, 68 English modules at the pin, commits and trees only) and on a deterministic analysis whose 39 self-checks pass. The target of 525 is the curriculum plan's figure, not an observation. The draft concludes that least-squares fits of a line, an exponential and a logistic curve cannot be told apart on this history and that no date for 525 is supported; its burst scenarios and negative controls are synthetic. Human subject review, learner trial, translation and publication remain pending.
